# Imam Zaniar Ahmad

> Official information about Imam Zaniar Ahmad's services, service areas, resources, and booking options.

[Official website](https://www.imamzaniarahmad.com/)

Imam Zaniar Ahmad is an Ontario registered marriage officiant, Nikah officiant, Islamic speaker, fundraiser, and community builder. He serves couples and organizations across Toronto, the Greater Toronto Area, and Southern Ontario.

## Main services

- [Nikah services and Ontario marriage officiation](https://www.imamzaniarahmad.com/nikah)
- [Ontario service areas](https://www.imamzaniarahmad.com/locations)
- [Lectures, conference speaking, media, and fundraising](https://www.imamzaniarahmad.com/lectures)
- [Reviews and testimonials](https://www.imamzaniarahmad.com/testimonials)
- [Contact and booking](https://www.imamzaniarahmad.com/contact)

## Service regions

- [Toronto and the GTA](https://www.imamzaniarahmad.com/locations/toronto-gta)
- [Mississauga and Brampton](https://www.imamzaniarahmad.com/locations/mississauga-brampton)
- [Oakville, Burlington, and Milton](https://www.imamzaniarahmad.com/locations/oakville-burlington-milton)
- [Hamilton and Niagara](https://www.imamzaniarahmad.com/locations/hamilton-niagara)
- [Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge, and Guelph](https://www.imamzaniarahmad.com/locations/kitchener-waterloo-guelph)
